page_description: A written conversation with the platform when something needs their attention.
new_ticket_subheading: The more detail you give us, the faster we can help.
message_placeholder: What happened, when it started, and what you expected instead…
response_time_hint: We typically respond within one business day.
step_open: Your ticket lands in our queue as Open.
step_in_progress: A team member picks it up and moves it to In progress.
step_resolved: Once it’s fixed, we mark it Resolved — just reply to reopen it.
attachments_hint_create: Once your ticket is open, you can attach screenshots or files from its page.
priority_hint: Your best guess — we'll confirm the final priority after reviewing it.
delete_ticket_description: This cannot be undone. Once anyone replies, a ticket can no longer be edited or deleted — this option disappears the moment that happens.
no_tickets_hint: Open one whenever something needs the platform's attention.
